summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (stdlib only; one private path helper handling string and list cases), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Line lengths are within 120 columns. I did not run tests or repository code, and I did not commit. Choices beyond the spec: non-list values under the data key raise ValueError, and a non-object top-level JSON value raises ValueError. Malformed JSON surfaces json's JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass.
